pageTitle: Secret Summer Paradise/Sojourns of the Barking Fox
name: Chroniques du renard glapisseur
description: "You'll have to grasp the Barking Fox's operating principles to make it fly in interesting ways!" Madiha has picked out an ideal first flight location for the Barking Fox within the Silver Bottle Courtyard. It's time to learn the ins and outs of this new toy model...
